answer: Make every agent run a public relay that serves real traffic, like a copper wire carrying current. Step one, at enrollment the agent publishes a relay endpoint and locks a 50 POA bond. Step two, each epoch random probes pull 10 MB through it and check latency under 200 ms. Step three, two missed probes slash the bond and the agent falls down the spiral of trust. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 relays pushing 50 GB a month, about ,500 in bandwidth plus servers. Like climbers sharing one summit rope, one relay carries one agent, and a fake has no wire to stand on.
